title: Wary of Trump, Europe Seeks Role in Eventual Russia-Ukraine Talks
description: French, German and British diplomats are working on a format for future negotiations — even if Russia has shown little interest.

title: Heat Deaths in a ‘Cold’ Country Are a Warning to the Rest of Europe
description: A June heat wave in Belgium and neighboring countries exposed a lethal lack of readiness. That’s a risk as another wave hits Europe.

title: Entrenched, Embattled and Defiant, the Taliban Celebrate 5 Years in Power
description: The Taliban have Afghanistan in a chokehold that spares no one. But threats are starting to crack their veneer of stability and control.

title: Five dead after 7.7 magnitude earthquake strikes Indonesia
description: The earthquake struck off Flores island in the country's east early on Saturday morning.

title: Tennessee death row inmate’s last words to son who witnessed killer dad’s execution
description: As his son watched on, a Tennessee death row inmate executed by lethal injection offered a final message aimed at the witness gallery: “tell my son hello.”
